description_en: Lists the custom domain names for a private gateway
description_zh: 查询私有网关自定义域名列表
kebab_example: aliyun eas list-gateway-domains --cluster-id cn-shanghai --gateway-id gw-1uhcqmsc7x22000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListGatewayDomains

parameters.help_en: The region where the private gateway is located
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the private gateway. To get this ID, see the GatewayId field in the response from the ListGateway (https://apiworkbench.aliyun-inc.com/document/eas/2021-07-01/ListGateway?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.765e281fL2IcjJ\&ampEnv=online) API operation
parameters.help_zh: 私有网关ID。如何获取私有网关ID，请参见接口ListGateway (https://apiworkbench.aliyun-inc.com/document/eas/2021-07-01/ListGateway?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.765e281fL2IcjJ&ampEnv=online)返回结果中的GatewayId字段
parameters.name: gateway_id
